newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Nov 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Nov 27.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A team of the International Committee of the Red Cross is in Bahrain to review the conditions of detainees and has visited detainees held in connection with anti-government protests in the island state.
- Russia's leading autoparts trading company Ross Ltd has launched a Dubai operation to sell to visiting Russian tourists.

- French company Giat has fulfilled 40 percent of its offset obligations in the UAE and hopes to achieve its target even if the privatisation of the Water and Electricity Department in Abu Dhabi is not accomplished on time.
- Bahrain Islamic Insurance Co has obtained government approval to launch an initial public offering to increase its paid-in capital, a company official said.

- The Dubai-based Al-Rostamani Group on Tuesday launched the UAE's first privately developed industrial estate in Sharjah's industrial area at a price of 150 million dirhams and covering an area of 270 hectares.
- The crown prince of Abu Dhabi has set up a committee for the privatisation of the water and electricity sector.
- A government study projected 1996 GDP in the UAE of $40.63 billion, rising to $42.01 billion in 1997 and $43.45 billion in 1998.
